purpose: Golden conformance matrix proving which mature Physics PR #156 and Chemistry PR #157 production invariants are inherited by the two-core architecture.

rows.invariant: Research truth is frozen upstream and learner Bxx is downstream
rows.evidence: ResearchBundle excludes Bxx; LearnerProfile and PublicationTarget bind downstream.

rows.invariant: Material claims carry exact source evidence locators for production handoff
rows.evidence: ResearchClaim evidence_refs plus FULL_TOPIC_PAIR handoff gate.

rows.invariant: Canonical scope registry is immutably hash-bound for production handoff
rows.evidence: ScopeGraph registry_sha256 plus FULL_TOPIC_PAIR handoff gate.

rows.invariant: External question content and source occurrence are immutable separate custody objects
rows.evidence: QuestionContentLedger + QuestionOccurrenceLedger + QuestionEvidenceLedger reconciliation.

rows.invariant: External-question denominator cannot silently shrink and REVIEW blocks closeout
rows.evidence: QuestionEvidenceLedger denominator/disposition validator.

rows.invariant: Source discovery/evidence authority is separate from reproduction rights
rows.evidence: Structured rights/use states and occurrence rights snapshot.

rows.invariant: Production Physics/Chemistry can require exactly two learner PDFs
rows.evidence: FULL_TOPIC_PAIR delivery contract.

rows.invariant: Study Guide and Transfer Book have reciprocal pair identity
rows.evidence: ProductIdentity pair_id + companion_product_id and package validator.

rows.invariant: Study Guide contains Appendix A Core Practice, B Core Solutions, C Printable Handout
rows.evidence: StudyGuide schema, renderer and package validator.

rows.invariant: Appendix C is standalone, introduces no new subject truth and contains no answer leakage
rows.evidence: Blocking Appendix C schema flags plus computed leakage gate.

rows.invariant: Transfer question begins with H0 independent attempt before hints/solutions
rows.evidence: Attempt.mode=H0, STOP boundary, separate solution section.

rows.invariant: Hints are typed H1 Notice, H2 Model, H3 Start and required depth is enforced
rows.evidence: TransferBook hint schema + semantic/package validators.

rows.invariant: PRIMARY concept is visually/semantically distinct from SUPPORTS concepts
rows.evidence: concept_labels hierarchy and validator.

rows.invariant: Mixed-transfer attempt hides concept/task/difficulty and reveals post-solution diagnosis
rows.evidence: MIXED_TRANSFER set schema and diagnosis coverage validator.

rows.invariant: Source locator/link and exam/year/shift metadata can travel with each transfer occurrence
rows.evidence: QuestionOccurrence custody and TransferBook source object.

rows.invariant: Difficulty preserves source code, normalized band, learner word and basis separately from transfer/task
rows.evidence: QuestionOccurrence source_difficulty_code and TransferBook typed difficulty/task/transfer objects.

rows.invariant: Complete solutions carry recap, why, method, answer/check, concept-to-keep and return target
rows.evidence: TransferBook solution schema and validator.

rows.invariant: Formula-only or near-answer solution methods cannot satisfy semantic closeout
rows.evidence: Minimum method substance gate plus required explanatory solution fields.

rows.invariant: Question repair route is explicit
rows.evidence: LOCAL_LESSON / SELF_CONTAINED / EXTERNAL_COMPANION repair object.

rows.invariant: Representation meaning is upstream; renderer/geometry is downstream; unsupported blocking type fails closed
rows.evidence: RepresentationRequirement + Shared Representation Layer capability registry.

rows.invariant: Required labels and representation dependency remain visible and auditable
rows.evidence: RepresentationInstance required/rendered label closure and Study Guide requirement ID check.

rows.invariant: Final learner artifact hashes and publication package digest are independently reconciled
rows.evidence: PublicationManifest plus independent package validator.

rows.invariant: PDF bounds and minimum font floor are measured from final PDF bytes
rows.evidence: PyMuPDF reinspection in publisher and independent validator; floor 7.5 pt.

rows.invariant: Internal-link and external-source-link structure is measured on final PDF bytes
rows.evidence: PDF link annotation inspection; Transfer Book requires one clickable source link per question.

rows.invariant: Notation probes are checked against final learner PDFs
rows.evidence: Formal-object notation probes recorded in PublicationAudit and independently enforced.

rows.invariant: Answer separation is measured on final Transfer Book PDF rather than asserted
rows.evidence: Attempt region checked for solution markers before Complete Solutions.

rows.invariant: Grayscale information safety is checked on final PDF drawing colors
rows.evidence: PyMuPDF drawing-color inspection.

rows.invariant: Human full-page visual review is bound to exact final PDF hashes at >=200 DPI and becomes stale on hash change
rows.evidence: PublicationAudit human_visual_review contract and validator stale-hash gate.

rows.invariant: Command/runtime evidence is hash-bound to publisher code and dependency lock surface
rows.evidence: runner_sha256 + requirements_sha256 + dependency versions in PublicationAudit.

rows.invariant: Automated technical PASS is distinct from human subject/pedagogy/publication approval
rows.evidence: release_state and PENDING human visual review.

rows.invariant: Physics production profile preserves PR #156 two-product/representation/QA policy without a chapter-local publisher
rows.evidence: physics-pr156.profile.json.

rows.invariant: Chemistry production profile preserves PR #157 two-product/Appendix/concept/notation policy without a Redox-local publisher
rows.evidence: chemistry-pr157.profile.json.
